lines.text: The IMF says AI spending is propping up the world economy.
lines.say: The IMF says AI spending is propping up the world economy.

lines.text: Its October outlook sees world growth of 3.1% in 2026, up a tick from July.
lines.say: Its October outlook sees world growth of three point one percent in 2026, up a tick from July.
That's still slower than three point five percent in 2025.

lines.text: The drag? The IMF assumes oil averages $96 a barrel in 2026, up nearly 41%.
lines.say: The drag? The IMF assumes oil averages ninety-six dollars a barrel in 2026, up nearly forty-one percent.

lines.text: So it sees global inflation at 4.7% in 2026.
lines.say: So it sees global inflation at four point seven percent in 2026.

lines.text: The US is forecast to grow 2.3%, the fastest in the G7.

lines.text: But it flags risks: the Middle East war, an AI profit reset, and rising debt.

post.title: The IMF says AI spending is propping up the world economy
post.ig:
The IMF says AI spending is propping up the world economy.
Its October 2026 outlook: world growth 3.1% in 2026, up from 3.0% in July but below 3.5% in 2025.
It assumes oil averages $96 a barrel in 2026 and sees global inflation at 4.7%.
The US is forecast to grow 2.3%, fastest in the G7.
Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook (Oct 2026), AP, Reuters, Axios.
News and education, not financial advice.
